d:
The Motorola Edge 70 Max is here! In this video, we unbox Motorola's latest performance-focused flagship and take a detailed look at everything it has to offer—from the Snapdragon 8 Gen 5, 7100mAh battery, 2K LTPO display and Qi2 magnetic wireless charging, to the cameras, software, gaming performance and more. Is this Motorola's best phone under ₹50,000? Watch till the end to find out!
